title: Pregnant Blend 3-Mix Solo #28 (대각 띠·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Uzbek woman, an adult, in her early 50s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size — but projecting forward prominently from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest,, every other curve of her oversized at once around it: enormous round hips flaring out more than three times the waistline's width, gigantic soft thighs. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, a jewelled brow ornament, deep red lips, warm olive skin, a regal composed expression, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real pores, real living eyes, 15 hoops piercings set with rubies in gold-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of mixed-metal an anklet. Full body painted in 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 37% of the way down her figure from the top and about 62% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain (a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with tiered lotus-petal work filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer (deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms), wide gold-leaf bands following the contours of the body, with eggshell-white scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework (an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with fine filigree linework filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
